scope: Complete ten-condition SMAC terran5v5 FF/GRU development pilot at1M decisions,training seed0; not10M or independent confirmation.

curves.scope: Development control, seed0: feed-forward versus private-GRU actors at 10000 samples/update for MAPPO, AR-PPO, BPPO, AgentMixer and identity modifier. Uses2 native environments x5000 decisions rather than paper50x200/release25x400; same1M budget and other optimization settings as small-batch pilot. Shared critic remains feed-forward. curves.area_rule: trapezoidal integral of logged evaluation means over actual training steps, divided by full budget

uncertainty.unit: training-seed mean; evaluation episodes are not independent training seeds
uncertainty.interval: percentile bootstrap, linear percentile interpolation; omitted below five seeds

curves.interpretation: All declared seeds must complete at the same settings and evaluation grid before aggregation. Intervals do not certify independent final seeds, protocol equivalence or paper superiority.

limits: one development training seed per method
all evaluations deterministic; local AgentMixer execution
no across-seed uncertainty or superiority claim
all final endpoints retained; no earlier-peak selection
